item.title: I can't find the function "Rootogram"
item.description: I need to plot a rootogram, but RStudio returns an error saying that the function rootogram does not exist. I'm using R version 4.2.2 and have both the ggplot2 and countreg packages installed. However, I can't seem to find the rootogram function, and I need it for my dissertation. Any help would be greatly appreciated.
